description:
The gf2-coding crate guides served as fact sources for the permanent pages. Once mined, they leave the crate and are preserved in the legacy mirror.

## Background

Inbound citations include the crate README and several `dev/active/` documents (`dev/active/fa787f85-documentation-overhaul/investigation.md` §3.5).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/gf2-coding/docs/` live under `dev/archive/legacy/<original-relative-path>`, moved with history preserved, and the original paths no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each inbound citation outside the mirror points to the permanent page covering the topic, to the mirror path, or is removed as design-history provenance.
- [hard] REQ-03: A link scan of the touched files reports no unresolved local link, and the Rust CI gate passes.
- [hard] REQ-04: The manifest records each row as complete.
title: Move gf2-coding crate guides into the legacy mirror
